meta.name: li-repurpose
meta.description: Turn one long asset - a YouTube video, podcast, newsletter, blog post, transcript or client call - into a week of LinkedIn posts. Use when the user says "repurpose this", "turn this into posts", "I have a video/newsletter/ transcript", or pastes a long piece of content and wants it on LinkedIn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一段长视频、播客或长文,拆成一周的领英帖子按时发布。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有视频或长文,却挤不出时间持续更新社交账号。
copy.tagline_en: Turn one long video, podcast, or article into a week of LinkedIn posts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have long videos or articles but no time to post regularly.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把一段长内容(视频、播客、newsletter、文章、转录稿、客户通话)拆成够发一周的 LinkedIn 帖子。它先列出提取到的论点、数字、故事、机制、失误等条目和数量,再按顺序排进一周,最后按你的要求一次起草一篇。
howto.when: 当你说「repurpose this」「turn this into posts」,或粘贴一段长内容并想把它发到 LinkedIn 时触发。若给的是 YouTube 链接且会话里有转录工具,它会先取转录稿,否则请你粘贴文本。

say.text: 把这份播客转录稿拆成一周的 LinkedIn 帖子
say.note: 先给出提取清单和数量,再排一周
按钩子公式逐篇起草,不一次性给四篇

say.text: 这份 newsletter 能拆出几篇帖子
say.note: 条目少于四条时它会说内容太薄

howto.what_en: After install, Claude turns one long asset — a video, podcast, newsletter, post, transcript or call — into a week of LinkedIn posts. It lists what it found with counts, orders the posts across the week, and drafts them one at a time on request.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "repurpose this" or "turn this into posts", paste a long piece of content, or share a video, newsletter or transcript you want posted on LinkedIn.

say_en.text: Turn this podcast transcript into a week of LinkedIn posts
say_en.note: Lists extracts with counts, then the week
Drafts that one post through /li-post and /li-human

say_en.text: How many posts can this newsletter give me?
